lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Spot diameter increases dorsally and posteriorly from the head region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid pattern on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent horizontal white scar or abrasion is visible on the lower lateral region below the gill slits. Several vertical linear features across the branchial region may represent healed trauma or deep dermal folds.
other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the lateral surface anterior to the gill slits, near the corner of the mouth.
